description: This source file defines functions and data structures related to port validation and management within the Chromium project's networking code. It includes lists of restricted ports, functions to check port validity, and mechanisms to allow exceptions for certain ports.

classes.name: ScopedPortException
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily allows a specific port by adding it to the explicitly allowed ports list upon construction and removing it upon destruction.

classes.name: ScopedAllowablePortForTesting
classes.description: A testing utility class that sets a scoped allowable port for the duration of its lifetime.

methods.name: IsPortValid
methods.description: Checks if a port number is within the valid range (0 to 65535).

methods.name: IsWellKnownPort
methods.description: Checks if a port number is a well-known port (less than 1024).

methods.name: IsPortAllowedForScheme
methods.description: Determines if a port is allowed for a given URL scheme, considering restrictions and explicit allowances.

methods.name: GetCountOfExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Returns the number of ports explicitly allowed.

methods.name: SetExplicitlyAllowedPorts
methods.description: Sets the list of ports that are explicitly allowed, overriding previous settings.

methods.name: IsAllowablePort
methods.description: Checks if a port is allowable, considering the list of allowable ports and scoped allowance.
